recentItems.title: Zelenskyy: SKIES OVER RUSSIA ARE CLOSED, there is room only for DRONES. Flights are already canceled
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian strikes are dealing a growing blow to the Russian economy and infrastructure: oil refining is shrinking, fuel shortages are rising, and Russian airspace is becoming increasingly risky due to drone activity. Zelenskyy warned airlines about the new reality in Russian skies. Meanwhile, Moscow continues its mass attacks on Ukrainian cities. Against this backdrop, Europe is discussing strengthening Ukraine’s air defense, transferring Patriot missiles, implementing new sanctions, and utilizing frozen Russian assets.

recentItems.title: Russia has "learned" to use AI, and now virtual "victories" are being passed off to Putin as reality
recentItems.description:
The Russian army is intensifying pressure in the Donetsk region, trying to break through Ukrainian defenses near Kostyantynivka, Kramatorsk, and Pokrovsk. However, the Armed Forces of Ukraine are holding back the attacks and conducting counterattacks. In the Sumy region, Russian propaganda even used an AI-generated video to claim the non-existent capture of a settlement. Meanwhile, Ukrainian troops are achieving success near Kupiansk, clearing captured positions. We analyze whether Russia is preparing new actions in the south and examine the current situation across key sectors of the frontline.

recentItems.title: Kremlin demands STRIKES on European ports and factories! Propaganda names ROCKET TARGETS
recentItems.description:
Russian propaganda is becoming increasingly open in threatening European and NATO countries. On state TV broadcasts, Vladimir Solovyov calls for strikes on Great Britain and talks about the destruction of European infrastructure, while Russian experts promote the idea of equipping missiles with nuclear warheads. In this episode, we analyze how the Kremlin uses nuclear blackmail and threats against Western countries in an attempt to intimidate European societies, weaken allied unity, and reduce support for Ukraine. Watch the video to find out why such rhetoric is becoming part of Russia's information war.

recentItems.title: Putin panically FEARS peace and the end of the war: Intelligence reveals dictator's biggest fear
recentItems.description:
More than 50 countries at the UN have called on Russia for an immediate ceasefire and the withdrawal of troops from Ukraine, yet Moscow has once again rejected these demands. Meanwhile, according to The Economist, Putin may fear the end of the war due to the threat to his own power and security. Against this backdrop, the Kremlin is reportedly preparing for a new wave of mobilization, tightening control over Russians, and hiding an increasing amount of state statistics. At the same time, threats of using nuclear weapons are once again echoing in the State Duma. Why the continuation of the war is becoming a matter of survival for the Kremlin — in this episode of InFocus.
